title: Property of the descended quasi-compact open
statement:
The constructed $W_{\lambda_W}$ is quasi-compact, and its inverse image in
$Y$ is exactly $W$.

proof.text: By the construction in [def-nagata-qc-open-descent], $W_{\lambda_W}=\bigcup_{a=1}^m\bigcup_{k=1}^{r_a}D(f_{ak,\lambda_W})$ is a finite union, where $D(f_{ak,\lambda_W})$ is the basic open of $f_{ak,\lambda_W}$ in $U_{a,\lambda_W}$. Each $U_{a,\lambda_W}$ is affine: it is the inverse image of the affine $U_a$ under $Y_{\lambda_W}\to Y_{\lambda_0}$, which is affine as the base change of the affine transition $S_{\lambda_W}\to S_{\lambda_0}$ (Morphisms, Tag 01SD). A basic open $D(h)$ of an affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is quasi-compact (Algebra, Tag 00E8), and a finite union of quasi-compact subspaces is quasi-compact, so $W_{\lambda_W}$ is quasi-compact.

Let $p:Y\to Y_{\lambda_W}$ and $p_\lambda:Y\to Y_\lambda$ be the projections. By [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound], $\lambda_a\leq\lambda_W$ for every $a$, so $f_{ak,\lambda_W}$ is the image of the lift $f_{ak,\lambda_a}$ under the transition map $\Gamma(U_{a,\lambda_a},\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(U_{a,\lambda_W},\mathcal O)$. In [def-nagata-qc-open-descent] the lifts are taken for the identification $\Gamma(U_a^\infty,\mathcal O)\cong\varinjlim_{\lambda\geq\lambda_0}\Gamma(U_{a,\lambda},\mathcal O)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-limit-global-sections-colimit], whose colimit maps are the pullbacks $p_\lambda^\sharp$; hence $p_{\lambda_a}^\sharp(f_{ak,\lambda_a})=f_{ak}$, and since $p_{\lambda_a}$ factors as $p$ followed by the transition $Y_{\lambda_W}\to Y_{\lambda_a}$, also $p^\sharp(f_{ak,\lambda_W})=f_{ak}$ in $\Gamma(p^{-1}U_{a,\lambda_W},\mathcal O)=\Gamma(U_a^\infty,\mathcal O)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-basic-open-pullback] applied to $p$, the open $U_{a,\lambda_W}$ and $f_{ak,\lambda_W}$, $p^{-1}(D(f_{ak,\lambda_W}))=D(f_{ak})$. Inverse images commute with unions, so $p^{-1}(W_{\lambda_W})=\bigcup_a\bigcup_kD(f_{ak})=\bigcup_a(W\cap U_a^\infty)$ by the chosen presentations of [def-nagata-qc-open-descent]. Finally the $U_a$ cover $Y_{\lambda_0}$, so their inverse images $U_a^\infty$ cover $Y$, and $\bigcup_a(W\cap U_a^\infty)=W$. Hence $p^{-1}(W_{\lambda_W})=W$.

split_report.summary: No new nodes were needed. The proof is split into quasi-compactness of the finite basic-open union and recovery of W by pullback along the common stage, citing the imported descent definition, the finite-upper-bound lemma, and the existing basic-open pullback tool lemma.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the two sentences of the blueprint proof: finite-union quasi-compactness, then common-stage transport and inverse-image equality.

tool_uses.why: Its statement gives the inverse image of each basic open under the canonical scheme morphism; the Nagata unit has no replacement node for this generic pullback fact.
Its statement says the colimit maps are the pullbacks f_i^sharp, which identifies the pullback of each lift with f_ak; the descent definition of this unit already cites it.
